title: Editor crashes with signal 11 when exporting a project and trying to include a 2 GiB file in the `.pck` file
body:
### Tested versions - Reproducible in: 4.3.stable, 4.4.1.stable. - Not reproducible in: 4.2.2.stable ### System information Godot v4.4.1.stable (49a5bc7b6) - cpe:/o:nixos:nixos:24.11 #1-NixOS SMP PREEMPT_DYNAMIC Sat Mar 22 19:56:59 UTC 2025 on Wayland - X11 display driver, Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - AMD Radeon RX 580 Series (radeonsi, polaris10, LLVM 18.1.8, DRM 3.61, 6.13.8) - AMD Ryzen 5 3600 6-Core Processor (12 threads) ### Issue description If I tell the Godot editor to include a large file (2 GiB) in a project’s `.pck` file, then when I try to export that project, the Godot editor crashes with this error: 
Godot Engine v4.4.1.stable.nixpkgs.49a5bc7b6 - https://godotengine.org
Inconsistent value (1) for DRI_PRIME. Should be < 1 (GPU devices count). Using: 0
OpenGL API 4.6 (Core Profile) Mesa 24.2.8 - Compatibility - Using Device: AMD - AMD Radeon RX 580 Series (radeonsi, polaris10, LLVM 18.1.8, DRM 3.61, 6.13.8)
